SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM orders.ordered_at) AS INT) AS BIGINT) AS "orders.order_weekday",
    CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM orders.ordered_at) AS INT) AS BIGINT) AS "orders.order_hour",
    SUM(orders.subtotal) AS "orders.cents",
    SUM(orders.subtotal) / 100.0 AS "orders.sales"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM orders.ordered_at) AS INT) AS BIGINT),
    CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM orders.ordered_at) AS INT) AS BIGINT)
), _cm_orders__subtotal_sum_partition_by AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(orders.subtotal) AS "orders.tot"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    )
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.order_weekday",
  _base."orders.order_hour",
  _base."orders.cents",
  _base."orders.sales",
  _cm_orders__subtotal_sum_partition_by."orders.tot"
FROM _base
CROSS JOIN _cm_orders__subtotal_sum_partition_by
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.cents" DESC
LIMIT 2
